reader_summary.headline: Ben and David are joined by Former Microsoft VP and Co-Founder of Xbox, Ed Fries.
reader_summary.overview: Ben and David are joined by Former Microsoft VP and Co-Founder of Xbox, Ed Fries, to discuss the Bungie acquisition and the development of Halo. Highlights include: Ed’s call with Steve Jobs after the acquisition, and sharing the stage with Steve and Bungie Co-Founder Alex Seropian at the Macworld Keynote. Bungie today, and the unlikely path to get there led by Harold Ryan.

key_points.text: How to find something that all parties want to get a deal done, the creation Peter Tamte’s spin-out Mac gaming studio.
Saving a project that’s off schedule and missing the mark.
Sponsors: Legora: Vanta: ServiceNow: Statsig: More Acquired!
